subject: Acme - Post-call TCO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - Post-call TCO recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation about your voice and search assistant pilot. Quick recap of what I heard and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Key pain points
- Current latency spikes during peak traffic (search queries) causing degraded UX and higher infra spend.
- High per-token cost for inference in current setup (open-source models run on standard GPUs).
- Need predictable monthly spend for pilot to get Procurement comfortable.

Goals for the pilot (90 days)
- Keep 95th percentile latency < 300ms for common queries.
- Target overall inference spend <= $8k/month for pilot (across both embeddings and generation workloads).
- Demonstrate 30% cost / token reduction vs current baseline via batching, KV caching, and prompt optimizations.

Proposed levers we discussed (high level)
1) Model selection & quantization: use a 16-bit quantized variant for generator and a separate smaller embedding model for search to reduce token cost.
2) Batching & concurrency: Redwood continuous batching can amortize per-token kernel overhead; typical gains 15–30% depending on QPS shape.
3) KV/prefix caching: for repeated prompts and search contexts, caching can cut repeated decode tokens by ~20–40%.
4) Smart routing: route lower-priority requests to cheaper model variants during bursts to protect SLAs.

Attached is an initial TCO worksheet (redwood_tco_v1.xlsx) with a simple token-economics model — assumptions are noted in tab "Assumptions". High-level numbers below are conservative estimates based on the usage profile you shared (~3M tokens monthly):
- Baseline (current infra): ~$11,500/month
- Redwood default config (no caching/batching): ~$9,200/month
- Redwood optimized (batching + caching + quant): ~$6,800/month

Next steps
- Alex: confirm the 3M tokens/month estimate and whether embeddings workload is included in that number (reply here).
- Priya: can you share Procurement's contracting timeline? We can prepare a simple monthly commitment option.
- Rafael (cc): will follow up with a 1-page pricing summary and contract/outbound from finance if we proceed.

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up early next week to walk through the TCO worksheet together. Let me know a couple windows that work.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- Usage: the 3M tokens/month is a good estimate for the pilot (includes both embeddings and generation). Embeddings are roughly 25% of tokens.
- Latency: 95th < 300ms is what our PM cares about. We can tolerate slightly higher p50 during spikes but 95th is the target.
- Procurement: target approval by end of July; they like monthly commitments for pilots.

Quick ask: can you add a row to the TCO that shows the delta if embeddings are moved to the smaller embedding model vs running embeddings on the same generator stack? That will help our FinOps folks.

Happy to do a quick walkthrough Wed or Thu morning PT — I have 9–11am PT open both days.
